approach: Backfill the two surfaces #58 enumerated and left unowned: the init skill's conduct at skills/init/, and the shared stdout encoder at cli/command-output/. Derive every claim from the shipped skill files and the encoder with its tests; where the implementation and a tidier contract disagree, report rather than normalize.
Blast radius: spec corpus, and test titles bridged to the new suite. No source module changes and nothing published changes, so no changeset.
skills/harness-init/ keeps the init command; the new node keeps the skill. Both name the split so neither restates the other.

why: Cold spec-judge returns ALIGNED with all three backward lenses passing on round three. Round one short-circuited at governance pre-flight because the conductor relayed only the two format bars it had loaded; the three actor bars and the two remaining fixed-universal governances were loaded and re-declared. Round two failed builder on the init node and oracle and architect on the output node: two extensions stated in prose had no path in the drawn graph, the executable path was specified with no goal asking for it, and the second entry point's rows were anchored to a graph that did not cover it. All four became decisions in the graphs with scenarios on each branch, and the extension rule was swept across both nodes. Round three verified every fix against the shipped source rather than the report, and re-ran the deterministic checks itself: suite, spec-state and overlap clean, 48 scenarios, and every output-layer scenario bridged exact-title to a passing test. Self-asserted within the derived auto-spec leash.
